title: High-Precision RCM Motion for Ophthalmic Robotics via Hierarchical QP Control and Authority-Guided Recovery Planning
summary: General-purpose manipulators can position ophthalmic instruments under a software Remote Centre of Motion (RCM). However, at some reachable configurations that are nonsingular for the tip task alone, the RCM and tip-tracking objectives conflict and the servo oscillates. We formalise this failure as a constraint-induced task singularity: the RCM-projected tip Jacobian loses rank while the unprojected tip Jacobian stays well conditioned. Thus, the effective tip authority collapses although the target remains reachable. We present a high-precision RCM servo architecture with built-in singularity recovery: for each commanded target, an authority-guided planner selects a well-conditioned arm configuration that reaches it and plans an RCM-consistent route, executed by a fixed hierarchical-QP controller. On a 200-scenario kinematic benchmark, the complete nominal-and-recovery protocol reaches 128/128 near-singular targets and 71/72 near-joint-limit targets (100% and 99%, respectively), with the software-RCM residual below 0.142 mm. On a physical 6-DOF arm it executes across four RCM entry points, with a worst-case kinematically reconstructed RCM residual of 178 μm and a median tip-regulation error of 32μm, within the 200μm control requirement adopted for the ophthalmic task.
tldr: This paper addresses a failure mode in software-based Remote Centre of Motion (RCM) control for ophthalmic surgical robots, formalizing it as a constraint-induced task singularity where the RCM-projected tip Jacobian loses rank. The authors propose an authority-guided recovery planner and a hierarchical QP controller to maintain precision, achieving sub-200 μm residuals in physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文针对眼科手术机器人中基于软件的远程运动中心（RCM）控制失效问题，将其形式化为一种由约束引起的任务奇异：RCM投影后的尖端雅可比矩阵秩亏。作者提出基于权威引导的恢复规划与分层QP控制器，在物理实验中达到低于200微米的精度。
summary_zh: 通用型机械臂可以在软件远程运动中心（RCM）约束下定位眼科器械。然而，在部分可达构型中，虽然仅针对末端任务而言是非奇异的，但RCM约束与末端跟踪目标相互冲突，导致伺服振荡。我们将此类失效形式化为一种由约束引发的任务奇异：RCM投影后的末端雅可比矩阵秩亏损，而未投影的末端雅可比矩阵条件数良好。因此，尽管目标仍然可达，但有效的末端控制能力崩溃。我们提出了一种具有内置奇异恢复能力的高精度RCM伺服架构：对于每个指令目标，一个由控制权引导的规划器选择可达该目标的良态臂构型，并规划一条满足RCM约束的路径，由固定的分层二次规划（QP）控制器执行。在200个场景的运动学基准测试中，完整的标称与恢复协议在128个近奇异目标中成功到达128个（100%），在71个近关节极限目标中成功到达71个（99%），软件RCM残差低于0.142 mm。在物理6自由度机械臂上，该架构在四个RCM入口点执行，最坏情况下运动学重建的RCM残差为178 μm，末端调节误差中位数为32 μm，满足眼科任务所采用的200 μm控制要求。

title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
summary: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. The planner is instruction-tuned on 208,928 samples from 32 public medical benchmarks, covering single- and multi-tool interactions across single and multiple rounds. We separately evaluate tool orchestration, response synthesis, and end-to-end execution on held-out samples. MMedAgent-Plus achieves tool-call accuracies of 91.0%, 98.1%, and 80.7% in single-tool multi-round, multi-tool multi-round, and multi-tool single-round settings, respectively. Given correct tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus achieves scores of 14.4-14.8 out of 15 for faithfulness, completeness, and conciseness across 600 evaluation samples. In end-to-end execution without pre-supplied tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus correctly invokes the required specialist in 90.6% of 350 evaluation cases spanning seven tasks. Its final-answer accuracy reaches 0.98, matching the dedicated leading specialist and exceeding the strongest baseline (0.28).
tldr: MMedAgent-Plus is a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 specialist models across 12 tasks and 8 modalities, enabling coordinated multi-step medical workflows. It is instruction-tuned on large-scale medical benchmarks and demonstrates strong tool-call accuracy and response quality in single- and multi-tool settings.
tldr_zh: MMedAgent-Plus 是一个多模态医疗工具使用智能体，通过视觉语言规划器协调18个专家模型，覆盖12个任务和8种模态，支持多步骤医疗工作流。它在多轮/多工具调用和响应生成上表现出高准确率与高忠实度。
summary_zh: 医疗工作流程通常需要多项相互依存的分析，但现有的专科和通用AI模型并非为协调这些分析而设计。我们推出了MMedAgent-Plus，一个多模态医疗工具智能体，它将视觉-语言规划器与18个领先的专科模型相结合，涵盖12项任务和8种模态。通过统一的工具接口，规划器选择专科模型，按顺序执行它们，并基于其输出综合生成响应。规划器在来自32个公共医疗基准的208,928个样本上进行了指令微调，涵盖单轮和多轮下的单工具与多工具交互。我们分别在保留样本上评估了工具编排、响应综合和端到端执行。MMedAgent-Plus在单工具多轮、多工具多轮和多工具单轮设置中的工具调用准确率分别达到91.0%、98.1%和80.7%。在给定正确工具输出时，MMedAgent-Plus在600个评估样本上的忠实性、完整性和简洁性评分达到14.4-14.8分（满分15分）。在未预先提供工具输出的端到端执行中，MMedAgent-Plus在涵盖7项任务的350个评估案例中，有90.6%正确调用了所需的专科模型。其最终答案准确率达到0.98，与专用的领先专科模型相当，并超过了最强的基线模型（0.28）。

title: A general-purpose System One decision model for clinical records
summary: Clinical care, health-system operations and biomedical discovery depend on extracting reliable answers from patient records, yet applying diverse clinical questions across entire populations remains computationally expensive. Here we present Clinical System One (CS1), a 4-billion-parameter decision model for fast, typed judgments from clinical records, along with two agentic harnesses in which CS1 works together with a generalist language model. CS1-4B is trained on 12.4 million questions and answers from 3.6 million patients across a multi-hospital health system, combining structured-data keys, observed outcomes and language-model supervision across clinical notes, diagnostic reports and patient timelines. It answers multiple typed questions in a single forward pass without task-specific retraining, and each answer carries a probability that can route uncertain cases to human review. On 963,408 held-out patients, CS1-4B outperformed open decision models up to 27 billion parameters on 13 of 14 tasks scored independently of its training teacher. Across 21 external data sets, its aggregate performance approached that of the strongest tested 27-billion-parameter model, with 6.4-fold faster inference in a matched workload. Integrating CS1-4B with a language model agent produced cited answers over complete multi-year patient histories and screened a patient population against the eligibility criteria of 17 registered clinical trials, placing four times as many judged-eligible patients among its top 20 candidates as keyword search while using 690-fold fewer language-model tokens than a language model reading every record. These findings support a division of labour in clinical AI, with small decision models performing repeated record reading and generative models formulating questions and synthesizing evidence.
tldr: Presents CS1, a 4-billion-parameter clinical decision model trained on 12.4M QA pairs from 3.6M patients, capable of answering multiple typed clinical questions in a single forward pass with uncertainty estimates, and demonstrates agentic integration with LLMs for record summarization and clinical trial screening.
tldr_zh: 介绍CS1，一个40亿参数的临床决策模型，基于360万患者的1240万问答训练，可单次前向推理回答多种类型临床问题并给出概率；与通用语言模型智能体结合，实现病历引用摘要和临床试验筛选，提出高效分工的临床AI范式。
summary_zh: 临床诊疗、卫生系统运营和生物医学发现均依赖于从患者病历中提取可靠答案，然而将多样化的临床问题应用于整个人群在计算上仍然成本高昂。本文介绍了临床系统一号（CS1）——一个拥有40亿参数的决策模型，能够从临床记录中进行快速、类型化的判断，并配备了两个代理框架，使CS1能够与通用语言模型协同工作。CS1-4B基于来自多医院卫生系统中360万患者的1240万个问题和答案进行训练，融合了结构化数据键、观测结局以及来自临床笔记、诊断报告和患者时间线的语言模型监督。它能在单次前向传播中回答多个类型化问题，无需针对特定任务重新训练，且每个答案都带有概率，可将不确定病例转交人工复核。在963,408名留出患者上，CS1-4B在14项任务中有13项（独立于其训练教师评分）优于参数量高达270亿的开放决策模型。在21个外部数据集中，其总体性能接近所测试的最强270亿参数模型，而在匹配工作负载下推理速度提升6.4倍。将CS1-4B与语言模型代理集成后，能够在完整的多年患者病史基础上生成带引用的答案，并根据17项注册临床试验的入组标准对患者人群进行筛选，其排名前20的候选患者中经判定符合入组条件的患者数量是关键词搜索的4倍，同时语言模型令牌消耗比逐份阅读所有记录的语言模型少690倍。这些发现支持临床AI中的分工模式：小型决策模型负责重复性的记录阅读，而生成式模型负责提出问题并综合证据。

title: EndoWorld-JEPA: Motion-Guided Global-Local Latent World Modeling for Endoscopic Video Representation Learning
summary: Endoscopic video contains state transitions induced by camera displacement, deformable tissue, and instrument interaction, yet existing pre-training methods treat dynamics implicitly. Inspired by action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive world models and by the observation that endoscopic optical flow contains both shared image-plane displacement and localized residual motion, we reformulate passive endoscopic video pre-training as causal motion-guided latent-state prediction. We present EndoWorld-JEPA, to our knowledge the first latent world-model pre-training framework designed for general-purpose endoscopic video representation learning. In place of recorded actions, calibrated poses, or robot kinematics, the model conditions prediction of the next latent state on motion observed up to the current state. Its Optical Motion-guided module separates dominant displacement from residual motion and converts the resulting evidence into an ordered temporal motion condition and spatial local-motion weights. Complementary global and motion-local predictors use these outputs: the temporal condition modulates both latent transitions, whereas the local weights define an auxiliary motion-local state that extends prediction from scene-level evolution to spatially selective dynamics. Patch-wise motion weighting emphasizes localized change while retaining anatomical context, and past-motion-window dropout randomly withholds the complete motion condition to reduce dependence on unreliable motion. This global--local formulation learns predictable visual--motion dynamics in representation space without reconstructing stochastic appearance artifacts. Evaluation shows that a common pre-trained checkpoint achieves strong transfer across four downstream benchmarks, supporting motion-guided global--local latent prediction as an effective pre-training paradigm for endoscopic video.
tldr: The paper proposes EndoWorld-JEPA, a motion-guided global-local latent world model for pre-training endoscopic video representations, treating video dynamics as causal latent-state prediction conditioned on optical flow. It demonstrates strong transfer across four downstream endoscopic benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出 EndoWorld-JEPA，一种基于运动引导的全局-局部潜在世界模型，用于内窥镜视频表征的预训练，将视频动态视为由光流条件化的因果潜在状态预测，并在四个下游内窥镜基准上展现出较强的迁移能力。
summary_zh: 内窥镜视频包含由相机位移、可变形组织及器械交互引起的状态转换，然而现有的预训练方法隐式地处理动态信息。受动作条件联合嵌入预测世界模型以及内窥镜光流同时包含共享像平面位移和局部残余运动这一观察的启发，我们将被动内窥镜视频预训练重新表述为因果运动引导的潜在状态预测。我们提出EndoWorld-JEPA，据我们所知，这是首个面向通用内窥镜视频表示学习的潜在世界模型预训练框架。该模型不依赖记录的动作、标定位姿或机器人运动学，而是基于截至当前状态观测到的运动来条件化下一潜在状态的预测。其光学运动引导模块将主导位移与残余运动分离，并将所得证据转化为有序的时间运动条件和空间局部运动权重。互补的全局与运动局部预测器利用这些输出：时间条件调节两种潜在转换，而局部权重定义了一个辅助的运动局部状态，将预测从场景级演化扩展到空间选择性动态。逐块运动加权强调局部变化同时保留解剖背景，而过去运动窗口随机丢弃则随机完全省略运动条件，以减少对不可靠运动的依赖。这种全局-局部公式在表示空间中学习可预测的视觉-运动动态，而无需重建随机的表观伪影。评估表明，一个通用的预训练检查点在四个下游基准上实现了强迁移，支持运动引导的全局-局部潜在预测作为内窥镜视频的有效预训练范式。

title: Velocity Optimization via Thermal Imaging Enhances Autonomous Tumor Resection
summary: Objective: To demonstrate and evaluate THERMO, a thermal-velocity optimization algorithm for autonomous electrosurgery, in ex vivo porcine tissue using the UR10e-based ASTR system. Methods: Thermography for Electrosurgical Rate Modulation via Optimization (ThERMO), a closed-loop algorithm that uses real-time thermal imaging data to minimize thermal injury while ensuring accurate cut margins, was tested on ex vivo porcine tissue. Histological analysis was performed to detect thermal injury extent at a cellular level, and 3D photogrammetric measurement was used to verify margin accuracy. ThERMO's performance was compared against two previously used fixed velocity methods. Results: ThERMO outperformed both fixed velocity comparison methods without requiring data-driven training or iterative tuning, reducing thermal injury by up to 52%, improving cut accuracy by up to 59%, and maintaining task completion speed. Conclusions: Closed-loop thermal feedback via ThERMO improves autonomous robotic electrosurgery by simultaneously reducing thermal injury and improving margin accuracy, reinforcing its value over fixed velocity approaches for tumor resection applications. Significance: This work advances autonomous robotic tumor resection by demonstrating that real-time closed-loop thermal feedback control can substantially reduce collateral tissue damage and improve surgical margin accuracy.
tldr: ThERMO is a closed-loop thermal-velocity optimization algorithm for autonomous electrosurgery that uses real-time thermal imaging to adjust cutting speed. In ex vivo porcine tissue, it reduced thermal injury and improved margin accuracy compared with fixed velocity methods, without requiring data-driven training.
tldr_zh: ThERMO是一种用于自主电外科手术的闭环热-速度优化算法，通过实时热成像调整切割速度。在离体猪组织实验中，相比固定速度方法，它减少了热损伤并提高了切缘精度，且无需数据驱动训练。
summary_zh:
摘要：
目的：在离体猪组织上，使用基于UR10e的ASTR系统，演示并评估用于自主电外科手术的热速度优化算法THERMO。方法：通过优化实现电外科速率调制的热成像算法（ThERMO），一种利用实时热成像数据来最小化热损伤同时确保精确切割边缘的闭环算法，在离体猪组织上进行了测试。进行了组织学分析以在细胞水平上检测热损伤程度，并使用3D摄影测量法验证边缘准确性。将ThERMO的性能与两种先前使用的固定速度方法进行了比较。结果：ThERMO在无需数据驱动训练或迭代调参的情况下，优于两种固定速度比较方法，热损伤减少高达52%，切割准确性提高高达59%，并保持了任务完成速度。结论：通过ThERMO实现的闭环热反馈改善了自主机器人电外科手术，同时减少了热损伤并提高了边缘准确性，强化了其在肿瘤切除应用中相较于固定速度方法的价值。意义：这项工作推进了自主机器人肿瘤切除技术，证明了实时闭环热反馈控制能够显著减少附带组织损伤并改善手术切缘准确性。

title: Offline Apprenticeship Learning for Human-Centric Environments
summary: Effective decision-making in human-centric environments such as Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and clinical healthcare requires policies that are adaptive, data-efficient, and ethically deployable. Apprenticeship Learning (AL) infers policies directly from expert demonstrations by recovering the underlying reward structure, enabling strictly offline learning without environment interaction. This dissertation develops a progression of offline AL frameworks organized around two challenges: reward modeling and demonstration quality. For reward modeling, EM-EDM clusters demonstrations by latent reward functions and induces cluster-specific policies, and THEMES partitions trajectories into temporally coherent sub-trajectories guided by a hierarchically learned reward regulator; across one educational and three clinical datasets, THEMES outperforms flat and hierarchical AL baselines. For demonstration quality, HALIDE integrates continuous quality signals into hierarchical policy induction, enabling principled reuse of mixed-quality data under distribution shift. CCHAL further attributes quality to individual decisions via Bayesian credit assignment, dual-arm criticality scoring that contrasts expert and non-expert behavior, and a Bradley-Terry contrastive IRL objective over failure trajectories, outperforming baselines including HALIDE on three clinical EHR datasets and an ITS dataset. Finally, a real-world classroom evaluation of StuEDM, an EDM-induced policy that preserves student agency and intervenes only on disagreement, shows significant learning gains over an Expert baseline and a higher pretest-adjusted posttest score than a CQL policy trained on a far larger corpus, while overriding students less than half as often. Together, this work establishes offline AL as a practical, data-efficient, and ethically viable paradigm for human-centric environments.
tldr: This dissertation develops a series of offline apprenticeship learning frameworks for human-centric domains such as intelligent tutoring and clinical healthcare, addressing reward modeling and demonstration quality, with real-world evaluation showing learning gains.
tldr_zh: 本论文针对智能辅导与临床医疗等人本环境，提出了一系列离线学徒学习框架，解决奖励建模和示范质量问题，并通过真实课堂实验验证了学习成效提升。
summary_zh: 有效决策在智能 tutoring 系统和临床医疗等人本环境中，需要具有适应性、数据高效性和伦理可部署性的策略。学徒学习（AL）通过恢复底层奖励结构，直接从专家示范中推断策略，实现在无需环境交互情况下的严格离线学习。本论文围绕奖励建模和示范质量两个挑战，发展了一系列递进的离线AL框架。在奖励建模方面，EM-EDM通过潜在奖励函数对示范进行聚类，并诱导出簇特定策略；THEMES则在分层学习的奖励调节器指导下，将轨迹划分为时间上连贯的子轨迹；在一个教育数据集和三个临床数据集上，THEMES优于平坦和分层的AL基线。在示范质量方面，HALIDE将连续质量信号整合到分层策略归纳中，实现在分布偏移下对混合质量数据的原则性重用。CCHAL进一步通过贝叶斯信用分配、对比专家与非专家行为的双臂关键性评分，以及针对失败轨迹的Bradley-Terry对比IRL目标，将质量归因于个体决策，在三个临床EHR数据集和一个ITS数据集上优于包括HALIDE在内的基线。最后，对StuEDM（一种EDM诱导策略，保留学生自主权，仅在不一致时进行干预）的真实课堂评估显示，其学习收益显著高于专家基线，且校正前测后的后测分数高于在更大语料库上训练的CQL策略，同时干预次数不到后者的一半。综上所述，本研究确立了离线AL作为人本环境中一种实用、数据高效且伦理可行的范式。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Machine Learning with Evidence-based Planning for Medical Image Analysis
summary: Deep learning has become the default tool for medical image analysis, driven by the open-source movement. However, achieving the best performance on a given task remains difficult, with architecture selection and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) still considered "more of an art than a science". Automated machine learning (AutoML) automates parts of model training, yet helps little in medical imaging: general-purpose approaches lack medical architectures and preprocessing, and medical-focused ones demand engineering expertise and remain confined to narrow tasks such as 3D segmentation. We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework that automates model training for diverse single- and multi-modal medical tasks through a natural language interface. Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by retrieving published results to guide model selection and configuration, and employs parallel HPO where multiple agents explore adjustment strategies concurrently. MedicalMLOmni achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks; PMC-VQA is the exception, where a vision-language model with broader pre-training leads. Backbone-matched controls attribute the gains to the framework, not the backbone. By removing coding requirements, MedicalMLOmni lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.
tldr: MedicalMLOmni is a multi-agent AutoML framework that lets medical users train models via natural language; it retrieves published evidence to plan model choices and runs parallel hyperparameter optimization, achieving top scores on 19/20 medical imaging benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MedicalMLOmni 是一个面向医学影像分析的多智能体 AutoML 框架，通过自然语言接口自动训练模型；它检索已发表结果进行证据化模型选择，并运行并行超参数优化，在 20 个基准任务中的 19 个上取得最优成绩。
summary_zh: 深度学习已成为医学图像分析的默认工具，这得益于开源运动的发展。然而，在给定任务上实现最佳性能仍然困难，架构选择和超参数优化（HPO）仍被视为“更像是一门艺术而非科学”。自动机器学习（AutoML）自动化了模型训练的部分流程，但对医学影像的帮助甚微：通用方法缺乏医学架构和预处理，而医学专用方法则要求工程专业知识，且局限于3D分割等狭窄任务。我们提出了MedicalMLOmni，一个多智能体AutoML框架，通过自然语言界面自动化多种单模态和多模态医学任务的模型训练。具体而言，MedicalMLOmni通过检索已发表结果进行基于证据的规划，以指导模型选择和配置，并采用并行超参数优化，多个智能体同时探索调整策略。MedicalMLOmni在20个基准测试中的19个上取得了最佳分数；PMC-VQA是例外，一个具有更广泛预训练的视觉语言模型在该任务上领先。主干网络匹配的对照实验表明，性能提升归功于框架本身，而非主干网络。通过消除编码需求，MedicalMLOmni降低了拥有丰富数据集但工程专业知识有限的领域专家的使用门槛。

title: Reliability-Guided Vision-Language Decoding with Text-Aware Skip Refinement for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation remains challenging when targets exhibit limited visual distinction, irregular structure, or substantial variation across imaging modalities. Medical text can reduce this ambiguity, but indiscriminate fusion may introduce unreliable guidance. We present RELiF, a vision--language framework that integrates text through reliability-guided decoding. Its Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG) adaptively controls cross-modal updates, while the Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA) refines high-resolution features using text guidance. RELiF is evaluated on radiographic, CT, and endoscopic segmentation tasks, where it shows competitive performance across diverse imaging characteristics and target appearances. Additional analyses examine efficiency and stability. The complementary uncertainty representation derived from the reliability response also shows an association with prediction difficulty, with higher uncertainty values occurring more frequently in pixels associated with segmentation errors. Code: https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF.
tldr: RELIF is a vision-language framework for medical image segmentation that uses a reliability-guided fusion gate and text-aware skip refinement to handle ambiguous visual targets; it is evaluated on radiographic, CT, and endoscopic segmentation tasks.
tldr_zh: RELIF 是一个用于医学图像分割的视觉-语言框架，通过可靠性引导融合门和文本感知跳跃精炼来降低视觉目标模糊性，并在放射、CT 和内镜分割任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 医学图像分割在面对目标视觉区分度有限、结构不规则或不同成像模态间差异显著时仍具挑战性。医学文本可减少这种歧义，但无差别融合可能引入不可靠的引导。我们提出RELiF，一种通过可靠性引导解码集成文本的视觉-语言框架。其可靠性引导融合门（RFG）自适应控制跨模态更新，而文本引导跳跃细化适配器（TSRA）利用文本引导细化高分辨率特征。RELiF在放射影像、CT和内镜分割任务上进行了评估，在多样化成像特征和目标外观下表现出具有竞争力的性能。进一步分析考察了效率与稳定性。由可靠性响应导出的互补不确定性表示也显示出与预测难度的关联，较高不确定性值更频繁出现在与分割错误相关的像素中。代码：https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF。

title: Gated Prototype Transfer for Zero-Support Medical Vision Language Model
summary: Realistic few-shot adaptation of medical vision-language models (VLMs) can leave low-prevalence classes without any labeled support. The training-free SS- Text+ solver remains operational in this setting, but its zero-support prototypes receive no visual adaptation and fall back to a purely textual class prototype. We in- troduce Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer (GProtoT), a pre-repulsion module that transfers supported-class visual residuals to missing classes using VLM similarity and an ontology-based clinical distance. A validation-free evidence gate scales transfer based on semantic relevance and residual agreement, thereby limiting unsupported extrapolation. In 50 paired realistic one-shot trials on MESSIDOR with FLAIR features, severe and proliferative diabetic retinopathy were absent from every support set. Relative to SS-Text+, gated ProtoT improved missing-class recall by 5.23 points, average class accuracy by 1.37 points, and the missing/supported recall harmonic mean by 1.83 points. It reduced negative- transfer frequency from 46-48% for ungated transfer to 2%, while at the cost of reductions of 1.20 percentage points in supported-class recall and 0.45 percentage points in top-1 accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-based gating provides a safety mechanism for the knowledge source. GProtoT is based on SS- Text+ and requires no gradients, validation data, or additional model inference, of- fering a low-compute path toward accountable adaptation under incomplete clini- cal supervision. Code is available: https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT
tldr: GProtoT introduces a training-free, gated prototype-transfer mechanism for medical vision-language models that improves adaptation to zero-support (missing) classes by transferring visual residuals from supported classes, using VLM similarity and ontology-based distance, with gating to reduce negative transfer; demonstrated on diabetic retinopathy classification.
tldr_zh: GProtoT 提出一种无需训练的原型迁移模块，利用视觉语言模型相似度和基于本体论的临床距离，将支持类别的视觉残差迁移到零支持类别，并通过门控机制降低负迁移，从而提升医学视觉语言模型在缺失/稀有类别上的适应能力；在糖尿病视网膜病变数据上验证了效果。
summary_zh: 现实场景中医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的少样本适应可能导致低患病率类别没有任何标记支持样本。训练免除的SS-Text+求解器在此设置下仍可运行，但其零支持原型未获得视觉适应，退化为纯文本类别原型。我们提出了门控知识引导的原型迁移（GProtoT），这是一种预排斥模块，利用VLM相似性和基于本体的临床距离，将支持类别的视觉残差迁移至缺失类别。无验证的证据门控根据语义相关性和残差一致性缩放迁移量，从而限制无支持的外推。在MESSIDOR数据集上使用FLAIR特征的50次配对现实单样本试验中，重度及增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变在每次支持集中均缺失。相较于SS-Text+，门控GProtoT将缺失类别召回率提升5.23个百分点，平均类别准确率提升1.37个百分点，缺失/支持类别召回调和均值提升1.83个百分点。它将无门控迁移的负迁移频率从46–48%降至2%，但代价是支持类别召回率降低1.20个百分点，top-1准确率降低0.45个百分点。这些结果表明，基于证据的门控为知识来源提供了一种安全机制。GProtoT基于SS-Text+，无需梯度、验证数据或额外模型推理，为在不完整临床监督下的可问责适应提供了一条低计算路径。代码见：https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT
